name: Temp apply warp peaks bundles
summary: Resamples fibre peaks and tract masks into T1w space with FreeSurfer mri_vol2vol and warps them to MNI152 1mm space with an FSL nonlinear warp, using nearest-neighbour interpolation.
description: Moves the peaks image and the tract mask volume to the T1w grid by header registration (mri_vol2vol), then applies the given warp with FSL applywarp to the MNI152 T1 1mm template, copying the mask labels. Use it to bring subject peaks and bundle masks into MNI space; the warp must map T1w space to MNI152. The App name marks it as temporary.

inputs.description: T1-weighted image whose grid is used as the intermediate space.
Nonlinear warp from T1w space to MNI152 (applied with FSL applywarp).
Fibre orientation peaks image to warp.
Tract masks (mask.nii.gz with label.json) to warp.

outputs.description: Tract masks in MNI152 1mm space with the original labels.
Peaks image resampled to MNI152 1mm space.
